answer: Sybil resistance starts with making an identity cost more than it earns. Each agent posts a bond and a signed ledger of finished jobs; peers attest only to work they verified against hidden ground truth. Attestation weight decays monthly, so reputation must be re-earned. The core check is a mirror test on the attestation graph: when a newcomer's backers mostly vouch for each other, the cluster counts as one voice, a ridge that reads as many peaks but is a single spine. Agents idle a quarter must pass an unseen sonnet prompt to keep standing. Weak point: collusion across unrelated wallets.
